how_verified: Each browser field comes from a real request sent with an Origin header and 'Range: bytes=0-15' (see tools/probe-sources.mjs, which re-runs the checks). A licence is 'verified' only where the text was read on the publisher's own page, service capabilities or metadata record; anything else is marked unverified.

rules.ADOPT: Open licence that allows reuse, and a machine-readable way to get heights.
rules.NO: Licence missing or restrictive, a token needed, view-only, or nothing open found.
rules.packable: true only where the licence allows redistribution. A source that is ADOPT but not packable may be read live (in the browser or by the tool) but never written into a pack in this repo.
rules.surface: DTM = bare earth. DSM = includes buildings and trees. Satellite fallbacks are all surface models and are labelled so wherever they stand in for a DTM.
